query: select coalesce(sum(case when $3='api' then e.amount_cents else e.quantity end),0)::bigint as "value!" from usage_events e left join usage_events original on original.id=e.corrects where e.subscription_id=$1 and e.occurred_at >= $2 and (e.kind=case when $3='api' then 'api_conversion' else 'pro_bytes' end or (e.kind='correction' and original.kind=case when $3='api' then 'api_conversion' else 'pro_bytes' end))
